name: Lasagna Sandwiches
assumptions: Yield estimated from 8 slices of bread making 4 closed sandwiches, consistent with nutrition facts stating '1 sandwich'.
Total time estimated from quick assembly (step 1) and skillet toasting/melting (step 2); no explicit prep or cook times given.
Sour cream, mozzarella, and butter confirm dairy.
Bread assumed to contain wheat gluten (standard sandwich bread).
No egg, fish, shellfish, nuts, peanuts, soy, or sesame listed; ambiguous items marked null.
instructions:
1. In a small bowl, combine the first four ingredients; spread on four slices of bread. Layer with bacon, tomato and cheese; top with remaining bread.

2. In a large skillet or griddle, melt 2 tablespoons butter. Toast sandwiches until lightly browned on both sides and cheese is melted, adding butter if necessary.

Nutrition Facts
1 sandwich: 445 calories, 24g fat (12g saturated fat), 66mg cholesterol, 1094mg sodium, 35g carbohydrate (3g sugars, 2g fiber), 21g protein.
